45.evidenceText: The road racing season end is getting close, which means it's time for CX again. Great start of the season for the @crelancorendon, with already 2 victories and another podium place at the first races of the season. The team rolls on our CRC 1100 SPLINE T for the 2026/2027 season.
45.extractionRationale: Reviewed three DT Swiss sources covering 2026/2027 product lines and gravel/road wheelsets. No evidence of Clik valve adoption was found. DT Swiss products mention SPLINE technology and disc brake specifications, but no Clik valve. No data provided for other major brands (Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval). Based on available evidence showing zero adoption, the percentage is 0%.

49.evidenceText: Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One R, Perfomance, RaceGuard, TLR, Addix, 45-622 Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve.
49.extractionRationale: Across all 5 sources provided, only the Bergamont Grandurance 10 (2026) model explicitly lists "Clik valve" in its valve specifications. The other bicycle models mentioned in the comparison pages (Giant Revolt Advanced 2, Trek Checkpoint SL 5, Liv Devote Advanced 2, BULLS MACHETE RX 1, Cannondale Topstone Carbon 3, Canyon Grizl CF 7, and Specialized Diverge 4) do not show Clik valve specifications in the provided evidence text.

50.evidenceText: Two distinct Clik valve pages identified: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - dedicated Clik Valve technical page with installation instructions; (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - FAQ page about bike tire valves featuring Clik Valve documentation. Other sources mention Clik Valve in search results but are not dedicated Clik valve documents.
50.extractionRationale: Counted unique URLs that are specifically technical documents, installation guides, or FAQ pages dedicated to or primarily about the Clik Valve. Pages 3-5 mention Clik Valve only in search result snippets but are about other topics (Aerothan tubes, tire construction, tubeless), so they don't qualify as Clik valve-specific documents.

56.evidenceText: The provided sources discuss Clik Valve technology, conversion kits, and accessories, but do not contain a list or specific count of inner tube models/SKUs featuring the Clik valve interface.
56.extractionRationale: No specific count or list of distinct inner tube models/SKUs with Clik valves was found in any of the 5 sources. The sources focus on the valve technology, conversion kits, and pump adapters rather than inner tube product inventory.

61.sourceTitle: Aluminum at a 4-Year High as Hormuz Disruption Reprices the Supply Chain | Investing.com
61.evidenceText: Three-month LME aluminum futures rose 1.7% to $3,571 per metric ton in mid-morning European trading on April 13, their highest level since March 2022.
61.extractionRationale: The current LME aluminum spot price is directly stated as $3,571 USD/t in all three sources. Source 3 provides the most recent and specific context, dated April 13, confirming this is the current three-month LME aluminum futures price per metric ton.
